question: Did Belka and Strelka survive their spaceflight?
short_answer: Yes, Belka and Strelka were two Soviet space dogs who orbited Earth 18 times aboard Korabl-Sputnik 2 on August 19, 1960, and returned safely to Earth—becoming the first higher living organisms to survive orbital flight.
full_explanation: Accompanying Belka and Strelka were 40 mice, 2 rats, and several plants. Strelka later gave birth to six healthy puppies, one of which (Pushinka) was gifted to U.S. President John F. Kennedy by Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev.
